items.title: Iran's exiled prince outlines his plan to manage Iran's transition
items.description: As the United States and Iran held their third round of nuclear talks on Thursday in Geneva amid heightened regional fears of the prospect of another war in the Middle East, Iran's exiled crown prince Reza Pahlavi says now is the time to move forward with military intervention.

items.title: Rising tide of new voters forcing a tax rethink on property
items.description: Australian real estate now is among the world's most expensive, and that has made it a red-hot political issue as demographics shift.

items.title: Thousands break into property market with 5% Deposit Scheme
items.description: The number of people buying their first home with a 5 per cent deposit surges after the federal government makes sweeping changes to the scheme.

items.title: Childcare centres face funding cuts after missing safety benchmarks
items.description: A further 19 centres put on notice last year have improved, but one has closed permanently and another is still to be assessed.

items.title: Inside the courts changing minds to reduce a booming prison population
items.description: The number of Indigenous people behind bars is rising. But some judges are bucking the trend by taking a different approach.

items.title: Hillary Clinton slams Epstein committee for grilling her instead of Trump
items.description: Hillary Clinton blasts a Republican-led congressional committee for summoning her to answer questions about Jeffrey Epstein while failing to push US President Donald Trump to do the same thing.

items.title: HungryPanda accuses riders of blackmail as worker dispute continues
items.description: The dispute between HungryPanda and some of its riders has taken another twist, with the food delivery company accusing some workers of intimidation and blackmail.

items.title: Former New Zealand prime minister Jacinda Ardern moves to Australia
items.description: Jacinda Ardern had been living with her family in the US, but a spokesperson says they are now "basing themselves out of Australia".

items.title: 'A patronising cop-out': Grace Tame responds to PM 'difficult life' apology
items.description: Grace Tame criticises Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's qualified apology after he described her as "difficult", saying "what a patronising cop-out".

items.title: One word unravels Albanese's week
items.description: The prime minister was this week evacuated from the Lodge over a bomb threat and later got stuck in a tit-for-tat with a former Australian of the Year.

items.title: Proactive and expressive: Matildas' master plan for Asian Cup glory
items.description: Although filled with familiar faces, the Matildas are now a completely different side to the one that captured hearts and minds at the 2023 World Cup. This is how a "proactive" Australian side is likely to line up at the Women's Asian Cup.

items.title: Australia has recorded its first death from mammalian meat allergy. How common is it?
items.description: Jeremy Webb's death in 2022 from a tick-induced red meat allergy is the first to be recorded in Australia. Here's what we know about mammalian meat allergy and how to avoid it.

items.title: Fungal infection cluster at Sydney hospital linked to deaths of two patients
items.description: The cluster of infections at the transplant unit at the Royal Prince Alfred Hospital late last year saw two people die, health bosses say.

items.title: Sexual relationship began after student graduated, former teacher tells court
items.description: Stephen Fane Noga has denied allegations he had sex with a former student while he was one of her teachers at Hobart Matriculation College in the 1980s.

items.title: Hundreds of women join support group in wake of claims against gynaecologist
items.description: More former patients of Melbourne gynaecologist Simon Gordon have come forward to express distress over their treatment with many joining a newly-formed private support group.

items.title: Quick, eco, delicate — what's the best wash cycle to use?
items.description: Eco, fast, cotton, heavy, intense cold? Experts on the most cost-effective and efficient wash cycles for your home.

items.title: Rescuers abseil down 350m cliff to reach hikers stranded in alps
items.description: Emergency service crews have conducted a 24-hour rescue mission, involving 350 metres of a vertical climb, to locate two hikers who became stranded on a ledge in the Snowy Mountains.

items.title: Australians will receive mobile alert in July under new emergency trial
items.description: Most Australians will receive a mobile phone alert in July this year, as part of a nationwide test of a new emergency warning system.

items.title: Danish PM calls snap election after standoff with Trump over Greenland
items.description: Denmark will hold a parliamentary election on March 24, Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen announces, seeking to capitalise on a surge in support for her defiant stance against US pressure over Greenland.

items.title: 'Awkward situation': Community angst continues over 3m waterfront wall
items.description: Tasmania's West Coast Council is holding monthly community meetings until April as it continues consultation over a concrete wall locals say is blocking views and restricting access to the working wharf.

items.title: Woman left 'devastated' after dog killed, father hurt in lightning strike
items.description: A woman describes her shock after learning her father had been seriously hurt and her dog killed in a lightning strike in suburban Perth on Thursday morning.

items.title: Children in camp for IS-linked families speak about attempt to get to Australia
items.description: The children of women with ISIS links stuck in a Syrian refugee camp talk about their attempt to leave last week, saying they dream of one day buying toys and ice cream in Australia.

items.title: Wieambilla property where officers died put up for sale in 'dilapidated' state
items.description: The property where two Queensland police officers were murdered has been put up for sale, with photos showing the house in a state of disrepair.

items.title: INXS nominated for induction into Rock & Roll Hall of Fame
items.description: INXS will be considered for induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame and is one of 10 first-time nominees on the ballot.

items.title: Hopes 'extremely rare' fossil will unlock answers about evolution of whales
items.description: A 21-million-year-old fossil found along Victoria's Bellarine Peninsula has been recovered in what has been described as one of the largest and most complicated excavations in the state's history.
